id./param/scenario/cs/a_130_cs_140.pack|cs_: "'Cornered'...? Hm hm hm! Hya ha ha haaa!
"It is you who have painted yourselves into a corner! Poor, drab fools!
"Behold! I am beauty personified! Artistry made flesh! I am Meltoa! Worship me!
"Worship the woman who lured poor innocent people into a trap so she could turn them into paintings!? Not likely!
"But why? Why did you do all of this?
"Ha! Why? For beauty, of course! Each of you will be a splash of colour on my canvas. Welcome such a fate!
"How I wish that greatest of beings had given me this gift sooner! Crossing dimensions, collecting colours... Such fun!
"The world is so much better for it! Your basest urges bring you to me, and I make you something less...ugly!
"I do not lie: the mural brings fortune, the fortune of becoming part of my masterpiece! HA HA HAAA!
